title: Tight Quantum k-Collision Bounds for Constant-Round Sponge
summary: Nontrivial quantum multicollision-resistance bounds are known for constant-round sponge, but determining tight bounds remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine tight quantum $k$-collision bounds for constant-round sponge.

scope.domain: Quantum security analysis of multicollision resistance for constant-round sponge constructions.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine tight quantum k-collision bounds for constant-round sponge.

citations.label: Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers

progress.summary: The source reports nontrivial bounds for multicollision resistance of constant-round sponge and states that these bounds are not tight. The remaining problem is to establish tight quantum bounds.
citation_labels: Alexandru Cojocaru et al., Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers
